title: Occupation Supplement on the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit
content:
An occupation supplement applies to the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit award for the occupation verified on the credit, together with the loan program on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File. It is added to the starting amount, before the award is raised to 500.00 when below it and lowered to the program's credit cap when above it.

| Occupation verified on the credit | Loan program | Occupation supplement |
|---|---|---|
| active military member or veteran | Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | adds 125.00 |
| active military member or veteran | any other program | adds nothing |
| law enforcement officer, firefighter or emergency medical worker | any program | adds 75.00 |
| any other occupation (such as a K-12 educator or a nurse) | any program | adds nothing |

**Clause.** An active military member or veteran on a VA file adds 125.00, a law enforcement officer, firefighter or emergency medical worker adds 75.00, and any other occupation adds nothing.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A veteran on a Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed file: adds 125.00.
- A veteran on a Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed file: adds nothing.
- A firefighter on any file: adds 75.00.
